title: jack daniels maker brown forman misses quarterly sales estimates 2026 09 02
text:
Sept 2 (Reuters) - Jack Daniel's maker Brown-Forman (BFb.N)
, opens new tab
 ​missed first-quarter ‌sales estimates on Wednesday, pointing ​to ​softer demand as inflation-hit ⁠consumers pull ​back on ​expensive spirits and younger generations increasingly moderate ​alcohol consumption.
The ​company posted quarterly sales ‌decline ⁠of 1% to $911 million, compared with ​analysts' ​average ⁠estimate of $914.9 million, ​according to ​data ⁠compiled by LSEG.
